title: You and I Are Polar Opposites and The Ramparts of Ice Celebrate Kocha Agasawa Anime Adaptations with New Collaboration Illustration
content: You and I Are Polar Opposites and The Ramparts of Ice have revealed a new special collaboration illustration as part of the ongoing “Kocha Agasawa Anime Year” project, celebrating the anime adaptations of both manga series by Kocha Agasawa.
author: Anime Corner

title: Skeleton Knight in Another World Anime Season 2 Reveals Cast for Same-Day English Dub
content: Crunchyroll revealed on Thursday the cast and the July 4 premiere for the English dub of the second season of the television anime based on Ennki Hakari 's Skeleton Knight in Another World ( Gaikotsu Kishi-sama, Tadaima Isekai e Odekakechū or Skeleton Knight, going out to the parallel universe) light novel series.
author: ANN

title: Mahjong Pros Licenses Golden Sakura, Maetel of the Glassy Sea Manga
content: Manga Mavericks announced during its panel at Anime Expo on Thursday the following new licenses from mahjong set company Mahjong Pros ' Mahjong Pros Publishing imprint: Maetel of the Glassy Sea follows Mizuhara from private doubt to the M.League spotlight, through marriage, rivalry, team glory, losing streaks, MVP…
author: ANN

title: Defying Kurosaki-kun Manga Gets New Live-Action Series
content: Kodansha announced on Friday that Makino 's Defying Kurosaki-kun ( Kurosaki-kun no Iinari ni Nante Naranai ) manga is inspiring a new live-action series adaptation that will debut on Fuji TV On Demand . The announcement did not mention any further details about the series.
author: ANN

title: Aikatsu Stars! Gets 10th Anniversary Film in Spring 2027
content: Bandai Namco Pictures announced on Friday that the Aikatsu Stars! anime will have a new anime film titled Aikatsu Stars! : Hoshiboshi no Progress (The Progress of the Stars) that will open in early spring 2027. The film celebrates the anime's 10th anniversary (the anime premiered in April 2016). The Aikatsu Stars!
author: ANN

title: BluPetal Reveals 2 Licenses, Gush Comics English Marketing, Digital Platform Launch
content: English manga publisher BluPetal announced at its panel at Anime Expo on Thursday that it has licensed Masashi Kumamoto's Last Heaven manga, and Raika Suzumi 's The Black World is Dyed in White Chalk manga. Both titles will release in both print and digitally in early 2027.
author: ANN

title: Ink Pop Licenses noho's My Neighbor Yokai Manga
content: Ink Pop describes the series: Yokai, Japanese creatures of myth, come to life in this cozy series following a talking cat and his neighborhood friends. Welcome to a town where people and all sorts of spirits and monsters live together in harmony!
author: ANN

title: Multimedia Project 'Alien Stage' Receives Anime Adaptation
content: The Animate Presents: ALIEN STAGE Panel at Anime Expo 2026 revealed that an anime adaptation of Vivinos' and Qmeng's Alien Stage multimedia project is in production on Thursday. Produced by LICO , the 12-episode sci-fi music drama aired from September 2022 to June 2025 on Youtube.
author: MyAnimeList

title: BluPetal to Release Animate International BL Titles Exclusively
content: English manga publisher BluPetal announced at its panel at Anime Expo on Friday that it now has an agreement with Animate International to be the sole agent and subdistributor for English-language editions of titles published by Animate International in worldwide English-language markets, effective October 2026.
author: ANN

title: Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi Anime's Trailer Unveils August 5 Debut
content: The "First Look | Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi " panel at Anime Expo presented a new trailer for Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi , the limited anime series spinoff from the Star Wars: Visions project , on Thursday. The trailer announces the series' August 5 premiere on Disney+ and Hulu .
author: ANN
